snippet.title: Can I Make a Roguelike in Just 1 WEEK? | Chemical Combat Devlog 1
snippet.description:
Hey guys! I'm finally back, and I bring with me a whole new game to make devlogs on: Chemical Combat. Developed for Blackthornprod's 5th game dev competition, the game had to be themed around 'Synergies', hence why I went for a roguelike focusing on chemical reactions. This devlog showcases my first week in the competition, but a lot has changed since then, so feel free to wishlist the game on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3490250/Chemical_Combat/

And also, here's the original video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Grzcmlw4rzE


💬 Join my discord server here!
https://discord.com/invite/NxDSW65sUY

🙋‍♂️ Support the channel by subscribing!
https://www.youtube.com/@sigmoiddev

🎬 Check out the rest of the devlogs!
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdCLXFnLGVkDi819PJWZBBoNhcDzZCGev


📖 Chapters:
0:00 - Intro
0:29 - Theme
1:13 - Planning
2:16 - Concept
2:47 - Environment
3:09 - Player
3:25 - Enemies
3:53 - UI
4:20 - Polish & SFX
5:20 - Future Plans
5:51 - Outro


🎶 Music:
massobeats - glimmer | https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kETJF0dijxM
massobeats - bonsai | https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BgjrxtC_WlE
 

🔗 Credits:
All Icons by Freepik on FlatIcon https://www.flaticon.com/
All Gifs from https://tenor.com/
Stock Images from Various Sources


I've switched from CapCut to DaVinci due to the change in pricing structure (premium is now basically required), which will make editing a bit more time-consuming while I'm still getting used to it.

📱Software:
Recording: OBS Studio 🎥
Editing: DaVinci Resolve🎬
Engine: Unity 🕹️
IDE: Visual Studio Code 💻
Theme: Rainglow - Rainbow 🌈
Pixel Art: Aseprite 🖼️
Planning: Obsidian🗒️
